Developer: [Toca Boca](https://www.snokido.com/author/toca-boca)   -   263 434 plays

It is a virtual world where players can imagine and create their own decorations in various living spaces. In this charming town, crossed by a peaceful river, there are 4 houses available that are just waiting to be furnished by you. You can let your imagination run wild by using all the furniture and accessories at your disposal to create unique living spaces. No restrictions will be imposed on you, as in this version of Toca Life, all items are unlocked and readily accessible.  
 Toca Life: Unlimited is a game that stimulates children's inventiveness by providing a space to explore, create, and tell stories in a playful and interactive way. It is an excellent tool for encouraging imagination and creativity while offering a safe and fun play environment.

## 📝 Description

Play Toca Boca Life Vacation free online and create unforgettable holiday adventures with airports, beaches, hotels, and hidden island mysteries. A creative sandbox role-playing game where you travel, explore exciting vacation destinations, and create endless holiday stories with dozens of interactive characters.  
   
 Toca Boca Life Vacation is a creative sandbox adventure where every trip becomes a brand-new story. Play free online in your browser and experience the excitement of traveling through airports, relaxing at luxury hotels, exploring sunny beaches, and uncovering mysterious island secrets.  
   
 Start your vacation at the bustling airport. Scan luggage through the X-ray machine, check in for your flight, visit the airplane cockpit, grab a snack during your journey, and enjoy every step of your travel adventure before arriving at your dream destination.  
   
 After landing, check into your hotel and settle into your vacation home. Enjoy delicious meals at the hotel buffet, explore every room, ride the elevator to the luxurious penthouse suite, and relax while taking in breathtaking views from the top floor.  
   
 Spend your days exploring the beautiful beach where you can swim, surf above ocean creatures, search for hidden treasures buried in the sand, and enjoy countless fun outdoor activities. Every location is filled with interactive objects that encourage creativity and imaginative storytelling.  
   
 Take a stroll along the lively boardwalk where you can shop for souvenirs, take fun vacation photos, enjoy tasty snacks, and discover entertaining attractions. Keep exploring because hidden secrets, mysterious statues, and underwater surprises are waiting to be found throughout the island.  
   
 Create your own adventures with 34 unique characters, each ready to participate in funny, relaxing, or exciting vacation stories. Mix characters between locations, invent family holidays, sightseeing trips, beach parties, hotel adventures, and much more with no rules or time limits.  
   
 Every object can be picked up, moved, combined, or interacted with, allowing players to create completely unique stories every time they play. Your imagination is the only limit.  
   
 With colorful visuals, charming animations, hidden secrets, and endless role-playing possibilities, Toca Boca Life Vacation delivers a relaxing and creative experience for players of all ages.  
   
 Designed as a smooth HTML5 experience, Toca Boca Life Vacation runs directly in your browser on desktop and mobile devices. Whether you're searching for free browser sandbox games, unblocked role-playing games, or family-friendly creative adventures online, this title offers endless vacation fun anytime, anywhere.

## What is Toca Life: City?

Toca Life: City invites you to paint an entire metropolis with your own ideas—one cozy studio, bustling café, and leafy park at a time. From the moment you lay the first brick, every decision is yours: pick a neighborhood vibe, design the buildings, and fill them with a cast of quirky citizens 🏙️. Love decorating? Jump inside any apartment and shuffle sofas, paint walls, add puppy beds, or hide secret pastries in the fridge (we won’t tell!). Prefer city-planning? Expand block by block, combining modern high-rises with vintage townhouses until your skyline feels alive.

Because everything runs right in the browser on PlayMiniGames, there’s nothing to install—just click Play and watch your city blossom. Whether you’re on a lunch break at work or sneaking in a late-night session on your laptop, loading times stay lightning-fast ⚡, and your progress sticks around thanks to cloud saving. Families appreciate the no-download model; younger gamers enjoy the friendly drag-and-drop controls; and seasoned simulation fans can sink hours into optimizing layouts for maximum happiness.

### A Living Sandbox in Your Browser

• Build limitless homes—from minimalist micro-lofts to rainbow-painted mansions.  
 • Furnish rooms with hundreds of items: canopy beds, neon signs, smart fridges, hamster wheels 🐹.  
 • Adopt pets and watch them interact with objects (pro tip: place a cat near the keyboard for instant chaos!).  
 • Dress residents in mix-and-match outfits, then stage surprise parties or rooftop BBQs to see dynamic reactions.  
 • Snap in-game photos to share on social or keep as design inspiration.

## Gameplay Tips

1. Rotate furniture before placing it to unlock extra layout options.
2. Combine matching color palettes across rooms—this boosts resident “comfort,” so they reward you with bonus décor tokens.
3. Drop musical instruments in parks; passers-by may start a spontaneous jam session that attracts new NPCs.
4. Want faster expansion? Complete daily design challenges for a stack of coins 💰 you can reinvest in premium plots.

### Why Play on PlayMiniGames?

• Instant Access – Start building in seconds, no hefty downloads or plugins.  
 • Cross-Device Freedom – Continue the same city on desktop at home and mobile on the go.  
 • Community Events – Seasonal design contests showcase the best user-made interiors; winners earn exclusive furniture sets.  
 • Secure & Safe – HTTPS encryption and strict moderation keep gameplay family-friendly.

### Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I play Toca Life: City online for free?  
 A: Yes! Just visit PlayMiniGames, press Play, and the game streams directly to your browser at no cost.

Q: Does it work on phones and tablets?  
 A: Absolutely. The HTML5 version adapts to touch controls, letting you drag, drop, and rotate furniture with your fingertips 📱.

Q: Do I need to create an account?  
 A: An account is optional. Playing as a guest is fine, but registering lets you store cities in the cloud and join community events.

Q: Is any download required?  
 A: None—everything runs client-side inside your browser, so your device stays clutter-free.

## Our Heritage

###### We have a looong history of creating and designing apps from a kid perspective. Curious to see what we've made over the years? Have a scroll!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Boca Days

###### Hang out, make friends, have fun!

Toca Boca Days was our first development of a 3D multiplayer universe. We made the decision to end development on Toca Boca Days. While we loved building this experience, we’re choosing to focus our efforts on other areas within Toca Boca.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Mystery House

###### Play with the strange

It’s that vacant-looking house on that eerie, silent street that no one seems to visit anymore. We all know the type, right? Missing streetlights, cracked sidewalks, scraggly weeds. And slouching in the dark there, almost daring visitors to enter, is this mysterious little house. If the visitors are curious and brave enough, we bet they could go inside and find wh-….well, who knows what visitors will find? Part of Toca Boca Jr!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Blocks

###### Combine and discover

With Toca Blocks, kids can construct worlds and fill them with adventurous paths. They can craft detailed obstacle courses, intricate race tracks or floating islands and meet the characters to discover each one’s unique abilities! Part of Toca Boca Jr!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Dance

###### Let's Dance

Whether you’re a dance master or you have two left feet, with Toca Dance every player is a star choreographer ready to create stellar dance routines! In this full version of Toca Dance players get more characters, more costumes, more songs and more fun! Part of Toca Boca Jr!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Hair Salon 3

###### Grab your tools and get styling!

Today’s a great day for creating something quirky, pretty, edgy or… anything fun, really! Toca Hair Salon 3 lets players cut, curl, color and style – any way they want! It all starts by picking a character from dozens of looks that can be customized, meaning that the play opportunities are endless!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Hair Salon 2

###### Cut, curl, color and style – Any way players want!

Cut, curl, color and style – any way you want! Our bestselling app Toca Hair Salon is back in an even better version, with new characters, new tools, new accessories and even more hairstyling fun!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Hair Salon Me

###### A new kind of selfie!

Give friends and family a totally new look! Simply snap a picture and be transported to a world of hair-raising fun! Curly, straight or purple? Create a funky hairdo any way you like. Grow it long or cut it short, shave one side or spray paint it every color of the rainbow.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Kitchen

###### Playing with food

Toca Kitchen lets players choose and prepare food for four hungry characters. Sliced carrots, fried fish or pureed broccoli? It’s up to you! Will the characters like what you serve? You’ll have to try to find out!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Cars

###### Buckle up, friends!

It’s time for Toca Cars! In Toca Cars players just do what feels right. No regular rules apply to our roads. Cruise through big puddles of ice cream, fly off jumps into a lake or build a huge pile of houses, stop lights, and mailboxes and drive right through. Ready, set, GO! Part of Toca Boca Jr!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Kitchen Monsters

###### Monstrous cooking

Someone must have left a window open … two monsters have snuck into the kitchen!! And what a mess they’ve made… Oh well, at least they seem friendly enough. They look hungry too! Try feeding them and see what they like!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Tailor

###### Design your own clothes

Time to get busy with those design skills! With Toca Tailor, players can create, combine and style fun outfits for four different characters. They can choose between lots of clothing designs, then tailor them by adjusting hems and lengthening sleeves.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Store

###### Playing shop!

Let your kids play store without any of the messy cleaning up afterwards! What kind of store do they want to play around – a toy, candy or food store? And do they want to run the shop or shop in it? No worries, no decisions are definite, everyone can try everything in this store!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Robot Lab

###### Let's build robots!

Who wouldn’t want to make their own cool robot? Toca Robot Lab lets players do just that! Build robots from pieces of scrap, then watch it fly! This game offers endless robot combinations resulting in a different robot every time.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca House

###### Move in at any time

Welcome to Toca House where players help five friends with fun chores around a cozy house. Loads of fun with 19 different mini-games where players do the dishes, iron, sweep, plant flowers in the garden and more.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Hair Salon – Christmas Gift

###### Cutting Santa's hair

Cut, color and style Santa’s beard and hair! In this Christmas edition of the smash hit Toca Hair Salon, players can choose between styling Santa Claus or trim and dressing a funny Christmas tree!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Hair Salon

###### Who wants a haircut?

Let your kids run their own Toca Hair Salon! Cut, color, comb, shave and blow-dry lifelike hair on six different cute characters. Using nothing but their fingers, they can create just about any hairstyle they want!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Tailor Fairy Tales

###### Once upon a time

Time to get busy with those design skills! With Toca Tailor Fairy Tales, players can create, combine and style fun outfits for two characters in a beautiful Fairy Tale setting! Choose between lots of clothing designs, then tailor them by adjusting hems and lengthening sleeves.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Doctor

###### Doctor for a day!

In this game, players examine and help patients by solving 21 fun puzzles and mini-games that take place in the human body. The beautiful artwork and fun sound make the experience even better!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Doctor Lite

###### Doctor for a day!

In this game, players examine and help patients by solving 21 fun puzzles and mini-games that take place in the human body. The beautiful artwork and fun sound make the experience even better!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Doctor HD

###### Doctor for a day!

In this game, players examine and help patients by solving 21 fun puzzles and mini-games that take place in the human body. The beautiful artwork and fun sound make the experience even better!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Doctor HD Lite

###### Doctor for a day!

In this game, players examine and help patients by solving 21 fun puzzles and mini-games that take place in the human body. The beautiful artwork and fun sound make the experience even better!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Birthday Party

###### It's a birthday party!

Time to invite friends and family to a birthday party – around an iPhone or iPad! In this fun sequel to Toca Tea Party, players get to choose a party theme, set the table, serve the cake – and, of course, give the birthday star a great gift!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Band

###### Play with sounds

Toca Band is getting ready for their big concert and needs our players’ help to mix beats and sounds together for their hit song! Toca Band is a fun and easy game that encourages children to explore music in a new creative way!Players can choose from 16 different cool characters – each with their own unique quirky sound and musical rhythms. Part of Toca Boca Jr!

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Toca Tea Party

###### Enjoy an iPad tea party!

Invite friends to a tea party served up from an iPad! Set the table, choose favorite cookies and cakes and serve the tea! Toca Tea Party allows players to have fun together in a way that stimulates their imagination.
